title: Texans WR Tank Dell sees "light at the end of the tunnel" in recovery from 2024 knee injury

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Texans WR Tank Dell sees "light at the end of the tunnel" in recovery from 2024 knee injury
sources.description: Texans wide receiver Tank Dell has not played in an NFL game since December 2024, but a return to the lineup appears to be on the horizon.
